run.access_mode: Playwright (scripts/puzzles.mjs, verify.mjs) + level tables read from the page + the game's solution verifier and solution bot (assisted)
run.scope: Level data integrity (102 levels), solvability, all 10 puzzle mechanics in the real game, fail flow (Try Again, Give Up, Add Slot), slot limits
run.summary: All 102 levels are solvable and every mechanic was won in the real game by playing its solution. The fail flow works. One minor bug: Add Slot from the Out of Slots popup has no maximum, so repeated fails grow the board to 10+ squeezed slots, past the 7 the Add Slot booster allows.

coverage.notes: 15 tables of 6 + 12 event levels; every picture exists; no picture used twice.
LEVEL CHECK 102/102 from the game's own solution verifier (#verify_all, 334 s), no unsolvable forced-puzzle variants. Assisted: relies on the game's verifier.

coverage.area: Puzzle mechanics in the real game
coverage.notes: mystery, frozen, hidden, linked, big, pipe, key, wood, cookie, mystery links: each level won by the solution bot at 8x (36-58 s), no script errors. Assisted.
Out of Slots cannot be dismissed by Escape/tap outside; Try Again restarts; Give Up returns without reward. The fail popup was opened with the debug 'Lose level' (assisted).

findings.title: Add Slot from the Out of Slots popup has no maximum: repeated fails grow the board to 10 squeezed slots (the booster stops at 7)
findings.environment: Web, 390x844 touch. Fails triggered with the debug 'Lose level' (assisted); Add Slot and the ad are the real flow
steps: Run out of slots, tap 'Add Slot' on the Out of Slots popup and watch the 3 s ad
Run out of slots again and repeat 6 times
findings.expected: Same limit as the Add Slot booster: 'Maximum slots reached' at 7 slots
findings.actual: Slots go 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10. At 10 they shrink to thin pills across the full width and the first slot's block is wider than its neighbours.

evidence.caption: Run 1: the last Add Slot rounds
Booster: if (g.slots.length >= 7) return toast('Maximum slots reached')

findings.suspected_cause: The fail-popup handler pushes a slot without the 7-slot check that useBooster('add_slot') has.
findings.suggested_fix: Apply the same limit in 'fail-addslot' and hide or disable the Add Slot button on the fail popup at 7 slots.
